name: hole_and_cap
desc: night/danger hideout needing no blocks: dig 2 down, cap the hole above you, wait for morning, then climb out (exit=stay keeps you in until you run leave_hole)

cooldown.text: this ground cannot be dug into safely (liquid, loose sand, rock floor or protected block)
cooldown.hint: walk 20 m to plain soil, or use dig_in / shelter if you hold blocks

steps.desc: wait inside until it is day and nothing hostile is near
climb out: break the cap, pillar up with the blocks you hold
